name: Meta Momentum Human Rig (MHR)
experiment: Fixed zero identity and expression; six existing skeleton poses fitted to native articulation with official limits. No SAM calls or image generation.
limitations: Pose fitting is approximate, with mean joint-position residuals of 2.9–4.5% of stature; not the same measure as Track A contact gaps.
Fingers remain neutral. There is no collision or contact solver in the native MHR experiment.
Pose corrections can reduce collapse but do not guarantee collision-free deep folds.
Native constraints can clamp head or shoulder adjustments; the test UI reports this.
The local Python service recomputes native mesh vertices. This behavior is not preserved by exporting an ordinary GLB alone.
